name: Tears of Rail
description: Congeals the corners once visited. Can be used as a substitute for advanced Trace Materials when they are insufficient.
story:
Frozen tundras, restless harbors, radiant metropolises, and forgotten sanctuaries... These distant corners once visited now shimmer before the eyes like a mirage, only to be sealed away within a teardrop of interwoven paths.

"The ends of the path vanish into the endless starry sky, one side tethered to the past, the other leading toward the future."
